NEC's Submarine Networks Team [NEC Official] 「NEC」のロゴに込めた本気度光海底ケーブル敷設船長期チャーターMade in Japanの力を世界に 【ポジションのアピールポイント】 ＜募集背景＞ 海底ケーブルシステムは、グローバルな情報インフラの重要な構成要素です。NECは長年にわたりこの技術のリーディングカンパニーとして、世界シェアが約３割、世界トップ３サプライヤの一角を占め、世界市場で高く評価されてきました。データ通信のトラフィックが急増する中、海底ケーブルシステムの需要はますます高まっており、弊社のビジネスもダイナミックに拡大しています。 日本で唯一のトータルシステムサプライヤーとしてこの進展を加速すために、さまざまな業界でシステムの設計、開発経験を持つエンジニアを、システム設計部門のエンジニアとして迎えたいと考えています。あなたの設計が、社会の発展に欠かせないグローバルな情報ネットワークを支えます。 ＜キャリアパス＞ 案件には数百億円規模のものも多く、ハイパースケーラーや各国を代表するナショナルキャリア等世界中の顧客と世界を文字通り繋ぐというスケールの大きな仕事に関わることができます。基本は日本ベースの業務であり、日本からグローバルビジネスの最前線を経験することが出来ます。 テレワークを活用したハイブリッドな働き方を取り入れており、業務内容やチーム運営を踏まえ、 原則として週2日以上の出社を基本とした勤務形態となります。 応募資格 / Qualifications プロフェッショナル（課長相当）の場合 【MUST】 ・官公庁・執行団体向け国家プロジェクトにおいて、公募要領の読み込みから提案書提出まで、一連の応募書類作成を主担当として行った経験を有する方 ・実務において英語を使用することに抵抗がなく、 英文資料の確認や海外関係者との簡単なメール可能な方 ・多様なステークホルダー（社内部門・外部パートナー等）と協調し、円滑なコミュニケーションを取りながら業務を推進できる方" 【WANT】 以下があれば望ましい ・英語でのビジネス実務経験（TOEICスコア600以上、または同等レベル） 主任の場合 【MUST】 ・官公庁・執行団体向け国家プロジェクトにおいて、応募書類または採択後報告書類の作成に実務担当として関与した経験を有する方 （主担当でなく、リーダーの指示のもとでの対応経験でも可） ・実務において英語を使用することに抵抗がなく、 英文資料の確認や海外関係者との簡単なメール対応が可能な方 ・社内部門や外部関係者と協調し、 指示内容を正確に理解しながら、主体的にコミュニケーションを取り業務を進められる方 【WANT】 以下があれば望ましい ・英語でのビジネス実務経験（TOEICスコア550以上、または同等レベル） 【求める人物像・ソフトスキル】 ・自律的に考え、積極的に行動できる方 ・複雑で不明確な問題に取りくめる問題解決能力 待遇 / Salary & Benefits 【採用形態・ランク】 ・正社員を想定 ・プロフェッショナル（課長相当） 〜主任 レベルを想定 【想定報酬】 プロフェッショナル（課長相当）の場合 ・年収930万〜1200万円程度 ・月給58万〜80万円程度（月額基本給58万〜80万円程度を含む） ※前職年収を考慮、当社規定による 主任の場合 ・年収680万〜930万円程度 ・月給44万〜61万円程度（月額基本給35万〜49万円程度を含む） ※前職年収を考慮、当社規定による

review_candidates.description: CMCC Position cod. 12839 Impact Modeller – Climate Risks, Energy Systems and Socio-Economic Resilience Deadline: October 31st, 2026 What We Are Looking For We are seeking two outstanding/ambitious mid-level researchers with a strong track record in climate impact modelling, environmental systems modelling, integrated assessment, or related disciplines to join the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE) at the CMCC Foundation in Milan, Italy. The successful candidates will contribute to the scientific development of next-generation climate impact modelling frameworks supporting climate adaptation, energy transitions, and resilience planning across vulnerable regions worldwide. The position focuses on understanding how climate change propagates through interconnected human and natural systems, affecting energy systems, water resources, ecosystems, food production, infrastructure, and socio-economic development. The successful candidate will lead the development of integrated modelling approaches capable of translating climate hazards into actionable information for decision-makers and supporting evidence-based adaptation strategies. A particular emphasis will be placed on modelling climate impacts across interconnected human and natural systems, including water resources, energy systems, food systems, biodiversity, and ecosystem services, integrating Earth system information with impact models, socio-economic analysis, artificial intelligence, and decision-support tools to support climate adaptation, resilience, and sustainable development. The successful candidates will play a leading role in shaping a new generation of modular, scalable, and policy-relevant impact modelling frameworks, working within interdisciplinary teams spanning climate science, engineering, economics, AI, and environmental systems analysis. Beyond scientific research, the position offers the opportunity to coordinate international research activities, supervise junior researchers and PhD students, contribute to strategic project development, and help shape the future research agenda of EIEE in climate impacts, adaptation, and resilience. About Us CMCC Foundation is a cross-cutting scientific research center on climate change and its interactions with the environment, society, the world of business, and policymakers. Our work aims to stimulate sustainable growth, protect the environment, and develop strategies for the adaptation and mitigation of climate change. CMCC's core objective is to conduct cutting-edge science, to train the next generation of scientists at both national and international levels, and to be a beacon for climate modelling. CMCC pursues fundamental and applied science with utmost scientific integrity, prioritizing data-driven science and providing data, information, and research results that can support informed public debate and decision-making processes. To achieve climate research objectives at the highest international standards, we invest in training all our talents, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can excel. At CMCC you will find a strong, professional environment. Join an inclusive community that values diversity, where every voice is heard and respected. Help foster a culture of innovation and societal change, where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive and succeed. Over the last decade, CMCC has experienced extraordinary growth. We are now embarking on a new chapter of our journey that will further boost CMCC’s global position in climate change research…Together! To learn more about this opportunity and submit your application, please refer to the following: ROLE The successful candidates will work within the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE), contributing to the scientific leadership of research activities on climate impacts, resilience, and integrated environmental modelling. The selected mid-level researchers will contribute to the development of innovative modelling frameworks, coordinate interdisciplinary research activities, support project management of large international projects, supervise junior researchers, and actively contribute to the preparation of competitive national and international research proposals. Responsibilities The selected candidates will: Lead the development of integrated climate impact modelling frameworks linking climate information with energy systems, socio-economic systems and adaptation strategies Coordinate scientific activities across interdisciplinary teams working on climate science, economics, engineering, artificial intelligence and environmental modelling Design and implement multi-sectoral climate impact assessments and resilience analyses under future climate and socio-economic scenarios Develop innovative methodologies integrating Earth system information, impact models, AI techniques and decision-support systems Lead the development of climate risk, vulnerability and resilience indicators to support policy and investment decisions Contribute to the scientific coordination and project management of large collaborative national and international research projects Supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and early-career scientists Develop new research directions and strengthen collaborations with leading international research institutions Contribute actively to fundraising activities, including the preparation and coordination of competitive research proposals (e.g. Horizon Europe, ERC, international foundations and philanthropic initiatives) Publish high-quality scientific research in leading international journals and represent CMCC and the EIEE Institute in international scientific networks and conferences Contribute strategically to the scientific development and long-term objectives of the EIEE Institute Requirements Mandatory requirements: PhD in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Climate Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics or related disciplines Demonstrated experience in climate impact modelling, integrated assessment, Earth system applications, environmental modelling or related quantitative disciplines Strong programming skills in Python and experience with scientific computing and environmental datasets Experience in developing models, scenario analysis and quantitative assessment frameworks Proven scientific publication record in peer-reviewed international journals Experience working in interdisciplinary and international research environments Excellent communication and scientific writing skills Proficiency in English (spoken and written, Italian not required), with strong writing and presentation skills Willingness to travel for project meetings and conferences Ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment Preferred qualifications: 3–8 years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience Experience coordinating research tasks or interdisciplinary work packages Experience supervising MSc students, PhD students or early-career researchers Experience in successful proposal writing and fundraising for competitive research projects Experience interacting with stakeholders and policy-oriented research Experience with AI/data-driven methods applied to environmental systems Familiarity with Earth System Models, Integrated Assessment Models, energy system models or climate services Duration, Compensation & Benefits Please note that this opportunity will be issued both internally and externally. The selected mid-level researchers will be based in Milan CMCC office The contract offered for this position will be a Coordinated and Continuous Collaboration contract, starting no earlier than 1 October 2026 and lasting for 12-24 months. The gross annual salary range for this position is 40,000 - 55,000 per year. The salary offered within the range will be determined based on years of relevant experience, level of seniority, specific technical skills, applying objective and gender-neutral criteria Welfare package of 2,000 Euro per year. Flexible working time as per internal policies Support during the immigration process, if needed PROTECTED CATEGORY Belonging to legally protected categories (ex L. 68/99) will constitute a preferential condition. Some fiscal benefits could be applied for repatriated workers or foreign researchers/professors, having the requirements defined by Dlgs 147/2015 (for repatriates) or Dl 78/2010 (for foreigners). CMCC is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status, and other legally protected characteristics. Please omit from your CV any data you or we might consider discriminatory. This job announcement is an invitation to express interest in the above-mentioned CMCC Position. By submitting their application, candidates confirm that they have read, understood, and accepted the CMCC Personnel Recruitment Rules, available on the 'Fondazione Trasparente' webpage, as well as the Privacy Notice regarding the processing of personal data, accessible at the following link. We will keep your information on file for up to 1 year.
